# `base/dialog`

Documenting or extending the dialog anatomy itself inside base.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Documenting or extending the dialog anatomy itself inside base.
- **Avoid when:** You are presenting a modal in an app — the portal, focus trap, scroll lock and async confirm lifecycle belong to features/overlays.
- **Consider instead:** `features/overlays`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { DialogContent } from "themelia-ui/base/dialog"
import "themelia-ui/base/dialog.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/overlay`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `DialogContent`

Kind: callable.

```text
({ className, ...props }: DialogContentProps) => React.JSX.Element
```

### `DialogContentProps`

Kind: type.

```text
Omit<OverlayContentProps, "placement"> & Omit<React.ComponentProps<"dialog">, "children" | "className" | "title">
```

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Overlay, dialog & sheet — `/overlay`

### Three presets, one surface

<Overlay>
  <OverlayTrigger render={<Button>Rename</Button>} />
  <DialogContent>
    <OverlayHeader><OverlayTitle>Rename project</OverlayTitle></OverlayHeader>
    <OverlayBody>…</OverlayBody>
    <OverlayFooter>
      <OverlayClose render={<Button>Cancel</Button>} />
      <OverlayClose render={<Button>Save</Button>} />
